title: Selecting and giving orders
summary: Tap something to select it, then tap the ground to send it there.
text:
Tap (or click) a drone, a combat unit, a colonist or a building to select it. A card shows what it is and what it is doing, with its buttons.

To send drones or units somewhere, tap the ground with them selected, or drag from a drone to the spot. Right-click also sends the selection.

- Hold or double-tap a unit: every unit of that type on screen
- Shift-click adds or removes a unit; on a computer, drag a box
- The ⚔ chip selects every combat unit (tap again to look at them)
- X makes the selected units stop and guard where they are
- Esc closes the build menu, stops placing, then deselects

You don't need to order units to shoot: they fire at the nearest enemy in range by themselves, even on the move.
